authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the guide prints no Device Inquiry reply.

21 CC pair(s) are the coarse controller alone, 0 - 127: each pair is a controller and its partner 32 above, MIDI's coarse and fine, and the Circuit Mono Station's guide says the second "is used to create an 8-bit message for a 0-255 value range" without saying which bit it carries. Oscillator 1 Tune Coarse (CC 27, fine CC 59); Oscillator 1 Tune Fine (CC 26, fine CC 58); Oscillator 2 Tune Coarse (CC 30, fine CC 62); Oscillator 2 Tune Fine (CC 29, fine CC 61); Mixer Osc1 Level (CC 20, fine CC 52); Mixer Osc2 Level (CC 21, fine CC 53); Mixer Sub Osc Level (CC 22, fine CC 54); Mixer Noise Level (CC 23, fine CC 55); Mixer Audio In Level (CC 25, fine CC 57); Mixer Ring Mod Level (CC 24, fine CC 56); Filter Frequency (CC 16, fine CC 48); LFO Rate (CC 18, fine CC 50); Modulation Matrix EnvToOsc1Pitch (CC 12, fine CC 44); Modulation Matrix EnvToOsc2Pitch (CC 13, fine CC 45); Modulation Matrix EnvToFilterFreq (CC 14, fine CC 46); Modulation Matrix LFOToOsc1Pitch (CC 28, fine CC 60); Modulation Matrix LFOToOsc2Pitch (CC 3, fine CC 35); Modulation Matrix LFOToFilterFreq (CC 17, fine CC 49); Modulation Matrix ModSeqToOsc1Pitch (CC 15, fine CC 47); Modulation Matrix ModSeqToOsc2Pitch (CC 19, fine CC 51); Modulation Matrix ModSeqToFilterFreq (CC 31, fine CC 63).
Left out, a CC pair that is not a controller and its fine partner 32 above: Patch Category (CC(8) 64:2), Envelope Trigger (CC(8) 73:0).
